known_facts: At 10:04 UTC, the checkout error-rate alert fired with a failure increase from 0.4% to 9%.
Deployment dep-1842 for checkout-api completed at 10:01 UTC.
Database latency increased around the same time as the checkout errors.
The external payment provider reported intermittent errors starting at approximately the same time.
A previous incident with similar symptoms involved an expired service credential.
missing_information: Details of the changes made in deployment dep-1842.
Logs or performance metrics showing whether there were issues with database connectivity or queries at 10:01 UTC and 10:04 UTC.
Detailed error logs from the external payment provider, including timestamps for when errors started.

candidate_hypotheses.hypothesis: The increased checkout error rate is due to changes in deployment dep-1842 which caused a degradation in system performance and database latency.
supporting_evidence: The timing of the deployment coincides with both the increase in checkout error rates and the increase in database latency.
evidence_needed: Detailed logs from the deployment to identify specific changes that could have caused performance issues.
Performance metrics showing a direct correlation between the deployment and increased latency or errors.

candidate_hypotheses.hypothesis: An expired service credential in one of the services involved (e.g., payment gateway, checkout-api) led to intermittent connectivity issues with the external payment provider, causing checkout failures.
supporting_evidence: The incident brief mentions that a previous similar issue was caused by an expired service credential.
evidence_needed: Verification of service credentials being active and valid at the time of the incident.

candidate_hypotheses.hypothesis: Increased database latency is a contributing factor to both checkout errors and external payment provider issues due to potential timeouts or connection failures.
supporting_evidence: Database latency increased around the same time as the checkout error rate increase and the payment provider's reported issues.
evidence_needed: Performance metrics that show database queries timing out at 10:04 UTC or causing connection failures.

reversible_next_actions.action: Review the changes made in deployment dep-1842 for potential performance impacts.
reversible_next_actions.justification: This will help determine if any code changes introduced during the deployment could be causing increased latency or errors.

reversible_next_actions.action: Check and validate all service credentials, especially those related to external services like the payment provider.
reversible_next_actions.justification: Ensuring that no credentials are expired can mitigate potential issues with third-party integration.

uncertainty_statement: The current analysis identifies multiple hypotheses as possible causes for this incident. Until more evidence is gathered and reviewed, it remains uncertain which hypothesis best explains the observed symptoms. Additional investigation into deployment details, service logs, and performance metrics will be necessary to identify the root cause with greater confidence.
